title: Spark Moth
theme: A tiny spark-moth climbs a twilight chimney of drifting steam vents and floating ledges, gathering spark-motes to light the lantern gate at the top.
mechanics: Run and jump between floating ledges with coyote time and variable jump height
Ride updraft vents that lift the moth upward
Ride moving platforms that carry the moth
Collect every spark-mote in a level to open the lantern gate
Touch the lit gate to advance; five hand-authored levels
